$comment: The native status of every field on the chat wire (POST /api/chat and its SSE frames). Read by scripts/generate-chat-wire-contract.ts, which stamps each status into contracts/chat/juno-chat-wire-v1.schema.json as `x-native` and fails `npm run native:wire:check` on a field nobody has classified. native: the Swift apps send or read it today (checked against the Swift sources under `swift`). planned: native means to; the gap is known. web-only: only the web sends or reads it, by decision; the note says why. A field under a native parent must be listed; a field under a planned or web-only parent inherits it. `nativeOnly` lists keys the Swift sends or reads that today's web does not define; each fails the check once the web defines it, so it moves into `fields`.

request.projectId.note: The Swift apps create a conversation (with its project) through sync before the first turn; only the web's first submission creates one here.

request.message.note: The Swift apps append the user turn through POST /api/conversations/{id}/messages, then send `regenerate: true`, so every native turn regenerates from the stored message.

request.clarification.note: Answering a clarification wizard in chat. The Mac strips the wizard fence from the transcript today.

request.preflightClarification.note: Answers to the pre-flight questions before a turn runs; no native composer for them yet.

request.artifactEdit.note: Canvas Ask / Modify on a selection (the quote card), deferred from Phase 3 (brief §7.1).

request.attachmentIds.note: Native attachments ride the appended user turn (POST /api/conversations/{id}/messages `attachmentIds`), not this body.

request.voiceMode.note: The web sets it for a turn spoken in voice mode; the Mac's voice path does not send it yet.

request.canvasEnabled.note: Legacy and native-only by origin: only an explicit false from an older build does anything (request.ts keeps it so shipped binaries never 400).

request.origin.note: Durable creation metadata for a conversation created by this request. The Swift apps create conversations through sync; the Electron client (native/desktop-electron) sends main_macos here.

request.clientRequestId.note: The durable first-submission pair (with clientMessageId). Native turns are appended first and deduplicated by the append route's clientId.

request.researchEffort.note: The Mac has no research levels (Phase 2 errata, Research): the server's default effort applies.

stream.meta.titleSource.note: Not decoded from the frame; the stored conversation carries it.

stream.meta.receiptState.note: Durable first-submission receipt; native never makes a first submission on this route.

stream.meta.resumable.note: Not decoded: the Mac tries GET /api/chat/stream/{generationId} and treats a 404 as not resumable.

stream.progress.note.note: The media progress row shows the stage and percentage only.

stream.done.memoryUpdated.note: The web's "Memory updated" note under a reply; the Mac learns of memory changes through sync.

stream.done.quota.note: The Mac reads usage from /api/profile/usage (the account popover and the composer's quota line), not from the frame.

stream.done.title.note: Titles arrive on meta and title frames and through sync.

stream.done.projectId.note: A chat filed into a project by the turn; the Mac picks the move up through sync.

stream.error.preservePartial.note: The Mac keeps whatever text it streamed whatever the flag says.

stream.error.conversationId.note: Durable first-submission terminal metadata, as meta.receiptState.

stream.error.failureCode.note: Durable first-submission failure code, as meta.receiptState.

ClientMessage.feedback.note: A reply is unrated when it finishes; ratings travel through sync and /api/messages/{id}/feedback.

ClientMessage.conversationId.note: The stream already belongs to one conversation.

ClientMessage.approvals.note: The Mac holds approvals from the approval frame and /api/approvals, not from the finished message.

ClientMessage.errorMessage.note: Failures arrive as error frames; the stored message's error line is not read from done.

ClientMessage.progress.note: Client-transient on the web (use-chat sets it); the server never sends it.

ClientArtifact.hasOlderVersions.note: Set only when a read carries a window of a longer history; the apps page older versions from sync today and will page them from GET /api/artifacts/{id}/versions.

ClientArtifact.deletedAt.note: Set only while the artifact is in Recently deleted, so a chat card can offer Restore. The apps drop a trashed artifact through its sync tombstone and have no Recently deleted view yet.

ClientArtifact.pendingSuggestion.note: The re-emit guard's waiting suggestion (Apply / Dismiss / Compare). The apps draw no card for a held tag and have no suggestion bar yet.

ClientArtifactVersion.draft.note: Marks the web design editor's unsealed working copy, presented as the version it will become. Only owner web reads include it; the apps edit designs in their own hosted editor and save whole documents with a base version.

ClientActivityEvent.artifactVerification.note: The artifact check's receipt (verified, repaired, refused) is not drawn on the Mac yet.

ClientActivityEvent.agentChange.note: Structured receipt for conversational agent configuration edits; native refreshes the agent record on turn completion.

ClientMemoryReceipt.sourceRef.note: The receipt's source link in the Activity panel.

ClientWorkSession.titleSource.note: Not read yet; a task's title is shown as sent.

ClientWorkSession.updatedAt.note: Not read yet; the Mac orders tasks by lastActivityAt, as the web does.

request.clientFeatures.note: The grammar the client renders (Tool calls & research rework, SPEC §2.2; web/tools-thinking-research, not on main). Today's server strips it: chatBodySchema is not strict.

request.locale.note: The reader's BCP-47 locale (the same rework); stripped by today's server.

stream.handoff.note: Background research's hand-off frame (the rework's research_background); today's server never sends it.

stream.handoff.runId.note: The research run the turn handed off to.

stream.delta.round.note: The rework's timeline grammar: which model round a delta belongs to.

stream.delta.phase.note: The rework's timeline grammar: the phase a delta is written in.

stream.reasoning.round.note: The rework's timeline grammar, as delta.round.

stream.error.error.note: An older server's error frame carried `error` rather than `message`; the Mac still reads it as a fallback.

ClientSource.origin.note: Where a source came from (the rework's citations); read when present.

ClientActivityEvent.seq.note: The rework's typed timeline: the row's order in the run.

ClientActivityEvent.round.note: The rework's typed timeline: the model round.

ClientActivityEvent.call.note: The rework's typed timeline: one tool call's record.

ClientActivityEvent.segment.note: The rework's typed timeline: a reasoning segment's position.

ClientActivityEvent.commentary.note: The rework's typed timeline: the model's commentary between calls.

ClientActivityEvent.notice.note: The rework's typed timeline: a coded notice with parameters.

ClientActivityEvent.fact.note: The rework's typed timeline: a fact the run established.

frameFields.ignoreExtraKeys: It also reads the session's own keys, which ClientWorkSession covers.

ClientWorkSession.ignoreExtraKeys: One reader for the task list, the task detail and this frame; the detail shape carries keys the frame's session does not (hostId, currentRunId, lastSeq, …).
